scope: Ordinary single-repository CLI module preflight plus public atomic service requested-analyzer failure; no fleet CLI preflight/non-atomic behavior expansion.

verification.environment: PYTHONPATH absolute workspace/src and pytest -o pythonpath same; .venv Python3.13

assertions: Original BadParameter details and CLI exit2 unchanged
Unwritable output preserves original usage error
Hidden direct-generation-output performs no diagnostic write
Service runidentity traversal cannot escape output
limitations: Best-effort diagnostics only when output is safe/writable
No actual scan timestamp when analysis never starts
Fleet CLI _select_modules preflight remains a separately scoped path
